source_summary: Environment variables from the PHP-FPM parent process (system environment, buildpack runtime). The comment indicates variables like LD_LIBRARY_PATH are passed. The #{PHP_ENV} template is expanded at compile time to produce env[<var>] = $<var> entries.
sink_summary: PHP application runtime environment accessible via getenv(), $_ENV, $_SERVER superglobals. Sensitive variables could be exposed to PHP code execution.
guard_summary: Default PHP-FPM behavior (clean env) is disabled. No explicit validation or filtering of which environment variables are exposed. The #{PHP_ENV} template suggests some variable selection occurs at build time but unclear if this provides security filtering.
risk_pattern: PHP-FPM configuration disables environment clearing, exposing parent process environment variables (potentially containing secrets, API keys, database credentials) to PHP applications.
context_summary: Configuration file comment indicates purpose: 'Pass environment variables like LD_LIBRARY_PATH. All $VARIABLEs are taken from the current environment.' Template #{PHP_ENV} is expanded at compile time to produce environment variable mappings.
